# okf-knowledge

Catalog knowledge exported from **golden**: 4 concepts, in bundle(s) 1. Each entry below is the concept's own document under `references/`; open one when the task touches its subject, and prefer `human-reviewed` entries when several overlap. Identities are `(bundle_id:concept_id)` in the catalog, which the pgokf MCP server can query live (`get_concept`, `concept_search`, `concept_neighbors`) for anything not included here.

## Skills

These Agent Skills packages from the catalog are installed beside this one, byte for byte (their `SKILL.md`, `scripts/`, `references/`, and `assets/`); the harness loads them like any other skill.

- [deploy](../deploy/SKILL.md) — unverified. Deploy the widget service safely with the bundled preflight checks. (1 script, 1 reference) `(1:skills/deploy/SKILL)`

## Contents
- [Widget failover](references/runbooks/failover.md) — Runbook · widget, oncall · unverified. Promote the standby when the primary widget node is lost. `(1:runbooks/failover)`
- [Widget failover appendix](references/runbooks/failover-appendix.md) — Runbook · widget · unverified. Supporting reference material for the widget failover runbook. `(1:runbooks/failover-appendix)`
- [Widget service](references/services/widget.md) — Service · widget, service · unverified. The primary transactional widget service. `(1:services/widget)`

Read [references/USING-THE-CATALOG.md](references/USING-THE-CATALOG.md) for how to query the live catalog (MCP tools, JSON API) beyond these files.

`scripts/okf.sh` queries the catalog's JSON API (`scripts/okf.sh search <query>`).

## Provenance

Built by pgokf-workspace from the catalog. `okf-workspace.lock` at the workspace root records the catalog snapshot and a content hash per file; `okf-workspace.yaml` reproduces the selection. Files marked reconstructed in the lockfile were rebuilt from indexed text because the bundle was ingested without stored source.
",
    ".claude/skills/okf-knowledge/references/USING-THE-CATALOG.md": "# Using the catalog (golden)

This package holds a selection of concepts from a pgokf catalog: a PostgreSQL-backed catalog of Open Knowledge Format (OKF) documents. Each concept has a stable identity `(bundle_id, concept_id)`, a type, tags, a lifecycle status, and a derived trust tier (`human-reviewed` > `machine-confirmed` > `unverified`). Prefer higher tiers when documents disagree, and cite the identity when you rely on one.

## Live access through MCP

`.mcp.json` configures the `pgokf` MCP server (the `pgokf-mcp` companion); the harness loads it from the workspace. Set `OKF_PG_URL` to a reader connection string in the environment that starts the harness.

Tools: `concept_search` (full-text query with `type`, `tags`, `status`, `trust_tier` filters), `find_similar` (more like a concept), `concept_neighbors` (walk resolved links), `get_concept` (a concept's fields and text), `get_skill` (a stored Agent Skills package), `list_plugin_targets` and `build_workspace_plugin` (rebuild a package like this one). Example:

```json
{"name": "concept_search", "arguments": {"query": "failover", "limit": 5}}
```

## The JSON API

The pgokf web UI serves the same catalog as JSON under `http://<pgokf-web host>:8080/api/`:

- `GET http://<pgokf-web host>:8080/api/search?q=<query>&limit=20` (add `type=`, `tags=`, `status=`, `trust=`, `bundle=`; with filters and no `q` it browses)
- `GET http://<pgokf-web host>:8080/api/concepts/<bundle_id>/<concept_id>`
- `GET http://<pgokf-web host>:8080/api/graph/<bundle_id>/<concept_id>?hops=2` and `GET http://<pgokf-web host>:8080/api/graph?bundle=<id>&limit=300`
- `GET http://<pgokf-web host>:8080/api/bundles`, `GET http://<pgokf-web host>:8080/api/health`

`okf.sh` in this package wraps those endpoints (`okf.sh search <query>`, `okf.sh get <bundle_id> <concept_id>`, `okf.sh graph <bundle_id> <concept_id> [hops]`, `okf.sh bundles`); it needs `curl` and reads `OKF_WEB_URL`.

## Rebuilding this package

`okf-workspace.yaml` at the workspace root records the selection and `okf-workspace.lock` the catalog snapshot with a hash per file; rebuild from the web UI's Plugins page or with the `build_workspace_plugin` MCP tool.

Run this when the primary [widget service](/services/widget.md) is
unreachable and streaming replication was healthy before the outage.

1. Confirm the primary is truly down.
2. Promote the standby.
3. Repoint the application connection string.
4. Capture a post-incident record in the [failover appendix](failover-appendix.md).

    ".claude/skills/okf-knowledge/scripts/okf.sh": "#!/bin/sh
# okf.sh - query the pgokf catalog through its JSON API (generated by pgokf-workspace).
# Usage: okf.sh search <query> [limit] | get <bundle_id> <concept_id> | graph <bundle_id> <concept_id> [hops] | bundles | health
# Needs curl; set OKF_WEB_URL to the pgokf-web base URL (default: http://localhost:8080).
set -eu
# Single-quoted: the shell expands nothing inside, so the URL below is data
# whatever it contains.
OKF_DEFAULT_URL='http://localhost:8080'
BASE="${OKF_WEB_URL:-$OKF_DEFAULT_URL}"
enc() { printf '%s' "$1" | od -An -tx1 -v | tr -d ' \n' | sed 's/\([0-9a-f][0-9a-f]\)/%\1/g'; }
case "${1:-}" in
  search) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { echo 'usage: okf.sh search <query> [limit]' >&2; exit 2; }
    curl -fsS "$BASE/api/search?q=$(enc "$2")&limit=${3:-20}" ;;
  get) [ $# -ge 3 ] || { echo 'usage: okf.sh get <bundle_id> <concept_id>' >&2; exit 2; }
    curl -fsS "$BASE/api/concepts/$2/$3" ;;
  graph) [ $# -ge 3 ] || { echo 'usage: okf.sh graph <bundle_id> <concept_id> [hops]' >&2; exit 2; }
    curl -fsS "$BASE/api/graph/$2/$3?hops=${4:-2}" ;;
  bundles) curl -fsS "$BASE/api/bundles" ;;
  health) curl -fsS "$BASE/api/health" ;;
  *) echo 'usage: okf.sh search|get|graph|bundles|health ...' >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
echo
",
